**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity), Section 6.1 (¶p0037).**

**What I found**

Section 6 ("Exclusivity") contains two covenants pointing in opposite directions:

- **§6.1 binds us.** For the *entire term* we may not participate in any similar Internet project for Deerskin Products — or for the sweeping open-ended category of "products substantially similar," which pulls in Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and unnamed "companies similar" to them — and HDI receives the exclusive right to the "Deerskin" brand online.
- **§6.3 binds HDI** (no similar projects during the term plus two years) and **§6.2** preserves our closeout-merchandise site. Both benefit us, so I left them untouched.

**Why this hits the walk-away line.** §4.1 renews the term automatically each anniversary, and §4.2 makes our own termination expensive (a Termination Payment keyed to trailing twelve-month Net Sales less $800,000, halved). So the restriction is indefinite in practice and our only exit is a paid one. The single performance hook, §1.6, expires 70 days after signature — after launch, HDI can underperform indefinitely while we stay locked up.

**Position taken: fallback, not preferred.** Outright deletion would be disproportionate here — this is a genuinely reciprocal bargain, with HDI funding development and hosting and giving up a two-year post-term covenant of its own. I therefore narrowed rather than struck:

1. Term cut from the rolling agreement term to a fixed **twelve (12) months** from the Effective Date.
2. Scope confined to **Deerskin Products**, deleting the elastic "substantially similar"/named-competitor extension.
3. Added **automatic termination** of the restriction on any HDI failure to meet service levels, availability requirements or delivery dates, including §1.6.

The redline validated `ok:true` before submission. Confidence 0.86 — the detection and direction are unambiguous; the residual uncertainty is only whether the business will accept the fallback or push for full deletion, given HDI's §6.3 covenant is the consideration on the other side of this trade.
